 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "avoidant", "description": "This means consistently withdrawing from challenging situations, difficult topics, and complex social interactions rather than engaging with them directly."},

  {"id": 5, "label": "introverted", "description": "This means being drained by company and restored by solitude: keeping to oneself, speaking little in groups, preferring one or two close friends to a crowd, and needing time alone after social occasions."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "news-avoidant", "description": "This means skipping the headlines on purpose, turning off the news, and going weeks without knowing what has happened."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "solitary", "description": "This means being solitary by choice: preferring one's own company, working, eating, and traveling alone, declining invitations without regret, and keeping other people at a distance rather than seeking them out."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "homebody", "description": "This means being happiest in one's own house and town, turning down every trip abroad, owning no passport, and home by nightfall."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "attention-seeking", "description": "This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "expressive", "description": "This means letting feelings show as they come, putting one's own joys, worries, and soft spots into words, and keeping no professional distance from anyone."},

  {"id": 13, "label": "reserved", "description": "This means keeping feelings out of sight, putting none of one's own joys, worries, or soft spots into words, and keeping a polite distance from everyone."},
